dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Thunder was surrendered to the care center by his previous owner due to the owner's health issues. They describe Thunder as a social and affectionate dog who enjoys spending time where his people are, and loves bath time, car rides, and head rubs. Thunder has shown highly social behavior with staff at the care center, frequently soliciting attention, but during the resource guarding portion of his handling assessment, he bit the prop hand, released, and bit again when it was used to remove a toy from his possession. Due to this behavior, we recommend Thunder be placed with a New Hope placement partner who is able to provide an experienced adult-only foster home, allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Thunder
